Fan Edit Idea: @sho_dexter: Angel Batista

Calling on Fan Editors out there to create a feature-length character study that tracks Angel Batista as the true moral heartbeat across all four live-action iterations of the franchise (Original Sin, the original series, New Blood, and Resurrection). Blending James Martinez's young portrayal with David Zayas' iconic performance, to weave a singular narrative of Angel's multi-decade police career, his profound loyalty to Dexter, and his ultimate, long-overdue pursuit of the Bay Harbor Butcher truth. It's time to honor Miami Metro's finest and give fans the perspective shift they've always craved.

Fan Edit Idea: The Godfather & The Freshman Mashup - The Fresh Godfather
An epic, chronological reimagining of Vito Corleone’s saga—tracing his origin in Sicily, his rise to power in New York, and a stealthy third act where Vito fakes his demise in 1955 to quietly re-emerge decades later as the elusive, lizard-importing "Carmine Sabatini."

Core Concept & Narrative Arc
By seamlessly splicing footage from The Godfather Part II, The Godfather, and The Freshman, this fan edit retells Vito Corleone's life as a continuous, three-act epic.

The core narrative pivot occurs during the garden scene in The Godfather. Instead of Vito collapsing and dying while playing with Anthony, the edit reframes his collapse as a non-fatal medical episode or staged disappearance. Decades later, a retired Vito—now operating under the alias Carmine "Jimmy the Toucan" Sabatini—runs a covert, high-society underground ring in 1990s New York while keeping a low profile.
